description: This source file defines a command-line script in Node.js that manages running test extensions in batch mode. It includes functions for parsing command-line arguments, resolving test plans for extensions, and executing test commands via spawning child processes. The script is intended to be run directly as a command-line utility for orchestrating tests across multiple extension configurations.

methods.name: runVitestBatch
methods.description: Asynchronously spawns a child process to run 'vitest' with specified parameters and resolves or rejects based on the process's exit status.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Outputs usage instructions to standard error.

methods.name: parseExtensionIds
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to extract extension IDs and remaining passthrough arguments.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main async function orchestrating the argument parsing, test plan resolution, and batch test execution.
